svg.title: One GRPO step on one GB10
svg.desc: One DGX Spark GB10 superchip: the Grace CPU and the Blackwell GPU stand on one 128 GB pool of unified LPDDR5X memory. On Grace run the Ray head, the TrainerController and ray::RolloutExecutor actors, and the math reward. On Blackwell the SGLang rollout engine and the FSDP trainer take turns, drawn to scale over a median step of 152.6 s: rollout 47.5 s, log probabilities 23.4 s, GRPO update 77.0 s, and weight update 0.64 s. The tenant that waits is parked in the same pool: the trainer onloads in 0.87 s and offloads in 0.76 s. Medians of 48 steps of a run made before we added the heat guard.
svg.text: ONE NVIDIA DGX SPARK · GB10 SUPERCHIP
BLACKWELL GPU · ONE STEP TO SCALE
dashed end: hand-offs and untimed work, 4.2 s
LPDDR5X, 128 GB unified, one pool for both chips
rollout: the SGLang engine writes 256 answers
log probabilities: the FSDP trainer reads them
weight update: new weights to the engine
Medians from the run made before the heat guard.
